cases.title: Send a transfer within the single-transfer limits
preconditions: Recipient is saved with a valid IBAN
cases.expected: The transfer is sent, the confirmation shows a reference number, and the transfer is the first entry in the transaction history.

ac_quotes.text: A single transfer must be at least 1.00 EUR and at most 10,000.00 EUR.
After a successful transfer the sender sees a confirmation with a reference number, and the transfer appears at the top of the transaction history.

cases.title: Minimum amount of 1.00 EUR is accepted
steps: Open Send money and select a recipient
cases.expected: The amount is accepted and the review screen opens.

ac_quotes.text: A single transfer must be at least 1.00 EUR and at most 10,000.00 EUR.

cases.title: Amount of 0.99 EUR is rejected
steps: Open Send money and select a recipient
cases.expected: The amount field shows a validation error and Continue stays disabled.

ac_quotes.text: A single transfer must be at least 1.00 EUR and at most 10,000.00 EUR.

cases.title: Maximum amount of 10,000.00 EUR is accepted
steps: Open Send money and select a recipient
Complete the OTP step and confirm
cases.expected: The transfer is sent and the confirmation shows a reference number.

ac_quotes.text: A single transfer must be at least 1.00 EUR and at most 10,000.00 EUR.

cases.title: Amount of 10,000.01 EUR is rejected
steps: Open Send money and select a recipient
cases.expected: The amount field shows a validation error, Continue stays disabled and no money leaves the account.

ac_quotes.text: A single transfer must be at least 1.00 EUR and at most 10,000.00 EUR.

cases.title: Amount above the single-transfer maximum is rejected
steps: Open Send money and select a recipient
cases.expected: The transfer is rejected with a validation error; a single transfer can be at most 10,000.00 EUR.

ac_quotes.text: A single transfer must be at least 1.00 EUR and at most 10,000.00 EUR.

cases.title: Transfer that keeps the daily total under the limit is sent
cases.expected: The transfer is sent and no daily-limit message is shown.

ac_quotes.text: The total of a customer's transfers in one calendar day must not exceed 25,000.00 EUR; a transfer that would take the total over this is rejected with the message "Daily transfer limit of 25,000.00 EUR reached".

cases.title: Daily total of exactly 25,000.00 EUR is accepted
preconditions: Two transfers of 10,000.00 EUR already sent today
cases.expected: The transfer is sent; today's total is 25,000.00 EUR.

ac_quotes.text: The total of a customer's transfers in one calendar day must not exceed 25,000.00 EUR

cases.title: Transfer that takes the daily total to 25,000.01 EUR is rejected
cases.expected: The transfer is rejected with the message "Daily transfer limit of 25,000.00 EUR reached" and no money leaves the account.

ac_quotes.text: The total of a customer's transfers in one calendar day must not exceed 25,000.00 EUR; a transfer that would take the total over this is rejected with the message "Daily transfer limit of 25,000.00 EUR reached".

cases.title: Transfer above 2,000.00 EUR asks for a one-time passcode
steps: Enter the OTP received by SMS
cases.expected: An OTP screen opens before sending, and the transfer is sent only after the correct OTP is entered.

ac_quotes.text: Transfers above 2,000.00 EUR require a one-time passcode (OTP) before they are sent.

cases.title: Wrong OTP stops a large transfer
cases.expected: The transfer is not sent and the OTP screen shows an error.

ac_quotes.text: Transfers above 2,000.00 EUR require a one-time passcode (OTP) before they are sent.

cases.title: Fee is 0.5% of the amount
cases.expected: The review screen shows a fee of 5.00 EUR and a total of 1,005.00 EUR.

ac_quotes.text: A fee of 0.5% of the amount is charged, with a minimum fee of 0.50 EUR.

cases.title: Fee for 100.00 EUR equals the minimum fee
cases.expected: The review screen shows a fee of 0.50 EUR.

ac_quotes.text: A fee of 0.5% of the amount is charged, with a minimum fee of 0.50 EUR.

cases.title: Fee below the minimum is raised to 0.50 EUR
steps: Send 98.00 to a saved recipient (0.5% would be 0.49)
cases.expected: The review screen shows the minimum fee of 0.50 EUR, not 0.49 EUR.

ac_quotes.text: A fee of 0.5% of the amount is charged, with a minimum fee of 0.50 EUR.

cases.title: Amount plus fee above the balance is rejected
steps: Send 99.80 to a saved recipient (fee 0.50, total 100.30)
cases.expected: The transfer is rejected with the message "Insufficient funds".

ac_quotes.text: A transfer larger than the available balance (amount plus fee) is rejected with the message "Insufficient funds".

cases.title: Amount plus fee equal to the balance is sent
steps: Send 100.00 to a saved recipient (fee 0.50, total 100.50)
cases.expected: The transfer is sent and the available balance shows 0.00 EUR.

ac_quotes.text: A transfer larger than the available balance (amount plus fee) is rejected with the message "Insufficient funds".

cases.title: IBAN with a wrong checksum is rejected
steps: Open Send money and choose New recipient
cases.expected: The message "Check the IBAN and try again" is shown and the amount screen does not open.

ac_quotes.text: An IBAN that fails the checksum is rejected with the message "Check the IBAN and try again" before the amount screen opens.

cases.title: Valid IBAN opens the amount screen
steps: Open Send money and choose New recipient
cases.expected: The amount screen opens.

ac_quotes.text: An IBAN that fails the checksum is rejected with the message "Check the IBAN and try again" before the amount screen opens.

cases.title: Transfer of exactly 2,000.00 EUR needs no OTP
cases.expected: The transfer is sent without an OTP step.

ac_quotes.text: Transfers above 2,000.00 EUR require a one-time passcode (OTP) before they are sent.

cases.title: Transfer of 2,000.01 EUR asks for an OTP
cases.expected: An OTP screen opens before the transfer is sent.

ac_quotes.text: Transfers above 2,000.00 EUR require a one-time passcode (OTP) before they are sent.
